title: 착륙 삼십 분 전
suno_analysis_sp: K-Ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. A lush string section provides legato accompaniment, with cellos and violins entering in the second phrase. The tempo is 68 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance is intimate and breathy, utilizing a wide dynamic range with subtle vibrato on sustained notes. The production features high-fidelity clarity with a hall reverb on the vocals and piano.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[grand piano playing melodic arpeggios]

[Verse 1]
[breathy baritone male vocals]
피아노 건반이 울린다
사진 속 웃음이 번지고 [strings enter softly]
그 위에 먼지가 쌓인다
손끝이 기억하는 것들
문 앞에 놓인 운동화 한 켤레
아직도 벗겨지지 않았다
아무도 신지 않는 신발이
